desc: This pixel art character is a solid bright green mannequin. The bright green colour is intentional (a chroma key) and must stay exactly the same bright green in every frame. Frame 1 already wears a steel longsword with a brown leather grip: copy exactly that design, colours and size onto the other frames. Add only a steel longsword with a brown leather grip, drawn in its own natural colours (no bright green on the item), identical design in all frames. Frames 2 onward, all facing north: 8 frames of a slash animation, then 6 frames of a hurt animation. Keep every other pixel, the pose, the outline and the transparent background unchanged.
